source_note: Curated from public hobby guides and surveys; see docs/research/easy_hobbies_shortlist.md. Generated by tools/build_easy_hobbies.py.

items.name: Fold a paper crane
items.about: The classic Japanese paper fold. A crane takes about twenty minutes and only a square of paper.
howToSteps: Cut any sheet of paper into a square.
Follow a beginner crane tutorial one fold at a time.
Crease every fold firmly before moving on.

ladder.milestone: Fold a modular model from 6+ units

items.name: Draw an object from life
items.about: Pick something in your room and draw what you actually see, not what you think it looks like.
howToSteps: Choose a simple object such as a mug or a shoe.
Sketch light outlines first, then add shading.
Spend at least 15 minutes looking more than drawing.

ladder.milestone: Draw a full room scene in perspective

items.name: Fill a page with one repeating pattern
items.about: Pattern doodling (often called Zentangle) is a calming, no-skill-needed way to start drawing.
howToSteps: Draw a border on a blank page.
Pick one simple pattern of lines, dots or waves.
Repeat it until the page is full.

ladder.milestone: Fill a page with one repeating pattern
Combine patterns on one tile daily for a week

items.name: Letter your name in three styles
items.about: Hand lettering and calligraphy turn everyday writing into something decorative.
howToSteps: Write your name in neat capitals.
Write it again in joined-up script with thick downstrokes.
Try a third style of your own, then pick a favourite.

ladder.milestone: Letter your name in three styles
Letter the full alphabet in one style
Letter a quote for a friend

items.name: Paint a simple sky gradient
items.about: A sky wash is the first exercise most watercolour painters learn.
howToSteps: Wet the top half of the paper with clean water.
Drop in blue at the top and let it fade downwards.
Add a band of orange near the horizon and let it dry flat.

ladder.milestone: Paint five skies at different times of day
Paint a scene from a photo you took

items.name: Make a rangoli at your doorstep
items.about: A traditional Indian floor design of coloured powder, rice or flowers, made to welcome guests.
howToSteps: Mark a grid of dots with chalk or rice flour.
Join the dots into a symmetrical design.
Fill it in with colours or petals.

ladder.milestone: Make a rangoli at your doorstep

items.name: Draw a mehendi pattern on your hand
items.about: Henna art is a celebration tradition across India. Start with a simple floral motif.
howToSteps: Practise the design on paper first.
Apply henna in thin, steady lines.
Let it dry for a few hours before scraping it off.

ladder.milestone: Draw a mehendi pattern on your hand
Do mehendi for someone at a celebration

items.name: Crochet a simple coaster
items.about: A round coaster teaches the chain, slip stitch and single crochet: the basics of almost every project.
howToSteps: Get a ball of cotton yarn and a hook.
Follow a beginner coaster tutorial.
Finish by weaving in the loose ends.

ladder.milestone: Crochet a set of four coasters
Crochet a small bag or hat
Follow a pattern for a blanket square set

items.name: Knit a 10 × 10 cm swatch
items.about: A practice square is how every knitter learns to cast on, knit, purl and cast off.
howToSteps: Cast on about 20 stitches.
Knit rows until the piece is square.
Cast off and admire your first fabric.

ladder.milestone: Knit a hat in the round
Knit a sweater or a cable pattern

items.name: Stitch your initial on cloth
items.about: Embroidery needs only a needle, thread and scrap fabric to get started.
howToSteps: Draw your initial lightly on a piece of cloth.
Outline it with a backstitch.
Fill it in with a satin stitch if you like.

items.name: Print a pattern with a block
items.about: India's block-printing tradition can be tried at home with a carved potato or a wooden block.
howToSteps: Cut a simple shape into half a potato, or use a wooden block.
Dab it in fabric or poster paint.
Print a repeating pattern on paper or cloth.

ladder.milestone: Print a pattern with a block
Print a cushion cover or tote

items.name: Shape a small diya or pot
items.about: Air-dry clay lets you try pottery without a wheel or kiln.
howToSteps: Knead a lump of air-dry clay until soft.
Pinch it into a small bowl or diya shape.
Let it dry for a day, then paint it if you wish.

ladder.milestone: Shape a small diya or pot
Model a small figure or animal

items.name: Make a quilled flower
items.about: Quilling rolls thin strips of paper into coils that form flowers and patterns.
howToSteps: Cut or buy thin paper strips.
Roll strips tightly around a toothpick and pinch them into petals.
Glue the petals into a flower on card.

items.name: Make a one-page collage
items.about: Collage turns old magazines and newspapers into art. There's no wrong answer.
howToSteps: Collect pictures and words around one theme.
Arrange them on a page before gluing.
Glue everything down and give it a title.

ladder.milestone: Make a collage series of three

items.name: Turn a jar or bottle into something useful
items.about: Give something headed for the bin a second life as a planter, lamp or organiser.
howToSteps: Clean a glass jar or plastic bottle.
Decide what it will become.
Paint, wrap or cut it to finish the job.

ladder.milestone: Turn a jar or bottle into something useful
Upcycle an old T-shirt into a bag

items.name: Draw a mandala
items.about: Circular, symmetrical patterns that build outward from a centre point. Very meditative.
howToSteps: Draw a small circle in the centre of the page.
Add rings of repeating shapes around it.
Keep each ring symmetrical and colour it in.

ladder.milestone: Draw a mandala with a compass and ruler
Paint a large mandala on a wall or canvas

items.name: Make a greeting card by hand
items.about: A handmade card means more than any shop-bought one.
howToSteps: Fold a sheet of card in half.
Decorate the front with drawing, cut-outs or stamps.
Write a personal message and give it to someone.

ladder.milestone: Make a greeting card by hand
Make cards for a whole festival list
Sell or gift a set of ten

items.name: Sew a simple tote bag
items.about: A tote bag is two rectangles and two straps: the perfect first sewing project.
howToSteps: Cut two rectangles and two straps from sturdy cloth.
Stitch the sides and bottom, inside out.
Attach the straps and turn it right side out.

ladder.milestone: Alter or repair a piece of clothing
Sew a simple garment from a pattern

items.name: Make a beaded bracelet
items.about: Beads and elastic thread are all it takes to make wearable art.
howToSteps: Pick beads in two or three colours.
Thread them onto stretchy cord in a pattern.
Tie a secure knot and trim the ends.

ladder.milestone: Make a set of matching pieces
Design a necklace as a gift

items.name: Draw a three-panel comic
items.about: Stick figures are fine. A comic is about the story, not perfect drawing.
howToSteps: Think of a tiny joke or moment from your day.
Split it into three panels: setup, build, punchline.
Draw it with speech bubbles.

ladder.milestone: Draw a comic a week for a month

items.name: Paint a pebble
items.about: Smooth stones make a tiny canvas for animals, patterns or kind messages.
howToSteps: Find a smooth, flat stone and wash it.
Paint a base colour and let it dry.
Add a design and seal it if you can.

ladder.milestone: Paint a themed set of five
Leave a kindness rock for a stranger

items.name: Make a Madhubani-style bookmark
items.about: Madhubani from Bihar uses bold outlines, fish, birds and double-line borders.
howToSteps: Cut a strip of thick paper.
Draw a double-line border and a simple fish or peacock.
Fill the shapes with patterns and bright colour.

ladder.milestone: Try Warli and Gond styles too
Paint a folk-art panel for your home

items.name: Journal for 7 days in a row
items.about: A few lines a day is enough to start a journaling habit.
howToSteps: Pick a notebook or notes app.
Write at least three sentences each day.
Read back the whole week on day seven.

ladder.milestone: Journal for 7 days in a row
Keep a journal for a full year

items.name: Note three gratitudes a day for a week
items.about: A short daily gratitude list is one of the simplest well-being habits.
howToSteps: Each evening, write down three things you are grateful for.
Be specific: name people, moments and places.
Keep going for seven days.

ladder.milestone: Note three gratitudes a day for a week
Keep it going for a month
Write a thank-you note to someone on your list

items.name: Write a haiku
items.about: Three lines of five, seven and five syllables. Small enough to finish in one sitting.
howToSteps: Pick a moment you noticed today.
Write three lines of 5, 7 and 5 syllables.
Read it aloud and adjust the words.

ladder.milestone: Write a poem a week for a month
Read a poem aloud to an audience

items.name: Write a 300-word story
items.about: Very short fiction is a quick way to start writing stories.
howToSteps: Pick a character and one problem they face.
Write a beginning, a turning point and an ending.
Trim it to about 300 words.

ladder.milestone: Submit a story to a magazine or contest

items.name: Finish a crossword
items.about: Newspaper and online crosswords build vocabulary and make a good daily ritual.
howToSteps: Start with an easy or quick crossword.
Fill in the clues you're sure of first.
Use crossing letters to crack the rest.

ladder.milestone: Solve one every day for a week
Solve a weekend puzzle without help

items.name: Solve a medium sudoku
items.about: Number logic with no maths required.
howToSteps: Pick a medium-difficulty puzzle.
Scan rows, columns and boxes for missing numbers.
Pencil in candidates when you get stuck.

ladder.milestone: Solve an expert puzzle in under 30 minutes

items.name: Complete a 500-piece jigsaw
items.about: A satisfying slow hobby, and good to do with family.
howToSteps: Sort out the edge pieces first.
Group the rest by colour or pattern.
Build outwards from the parts you recognise.

ladder.milestone: Do a puzzle swap with friends

items.name: Play a full game of chess
items.about: Chess began in India as chaturanga. Learn the moves and play one game to the end.
howToSteps: Learn how each piece moves.
Play a friend or a free beginner app.
Finish the game, win or lose.

ladder.milestone: Play a full game of chess
Play in a local or online tournament

items.name: Solve a 3×3 cube
items.about: With the layer-by-layer beginner method, anyone can solve the cube.
howToSteps: Learn the beginner method from a tutorial.
Solve one layer at a time.
Complete the whole cube once without help.

items.name: Learn a poem or shloka by heart
items.about: Memorising verse is an old Indian learning tradition and good exercise for the brain.
howToSteps: Choose a short poem, doha or shloka.
Learn it two lines at a time.
Recite the whole thing from memory.

ladder.milestone: Learn a poem or shloka by heart
Recite one for family or friends
Memorise a long poem or chapter

items.name: Write your name in another Indian script
items.about: India has more than a dozen scripts. Try Devanagari, Tamil, Bengali, Gurmukhi or another.
howToSteps: Pick a script you can't yet read.
Learn the letters that spell your name.
Write your name neatly ten times.

ladder.milestone: Write your name in another Indian script
Read a street sign or headline

items.name: Learn 20 words in a new language
items.about: A first vocabulary of greetings, numbers and food words.
howToSteps: Pick a language you're curious about.
Learn greetings, numbers 1–10 and a few foods.
Test yourself the next day.

ladder.milestone: Learn 20 words in a new language

items.name: Meditate 10 minutes a day for 7 days
items.about: Sitting quietly and following the breath is the simplest form of meditation.
howToSteps: Sit comfortably somewhere quiet.
Follow your breath, and return to it when your mind wanders.
Repeat daily for a week.

ladder.milestone: Meditate 10 minutes a day for 7 days
Join a group or silent retreat day

items.name: Read a short book in a week
items.about: Pick something under 200 pages and read a little every day.
howToSteps: Choose a short novel, memoir or graphic novel.
Read 25–30 pages a day.
Finish it and note one line you loved.

ladder.milestone: Read a short book in a week
Read a book a month for three months
Read a book in a new genre

items.name: Write a letter by hand
items.about: A handwritten letter is slow, personal and memorable.
howToSteps: Pick someone you haven't spoken to in a while.
Write a page about your life and ask about theirs.
Post it or hand it over.

items.name: Play a game of Scrabble
items.about: Word games are fun with family and sneakily build vocabulary.
howToSteps: Get a board or a free word-game app.
Play a full game with someone.
Look up one new word you learned.

ladder.milestone: Play in a club or online league

items.name: Record your dreams for 5 nights
items.about: Keep a notebook by your bed and write as soon as you wake.
howToSteps: Put a notebook and pen beside your bed.
Write down whatever you remember on waking.
After five nights, look for patterns.

ladder.milestone: Keep it going for a month
Turn a dream into a story or drawing

items.name: Write a review of a film you loved
items.about: Putting your opinion into words helps you notice more in what you watch.
howToSteps: Pick a film or series you enjoyed.
Write what worked, what didn't and who it's for.
Keep it to about 300 words and share it.

ladder.milestone: Write a review of a film you loved
Start a review blog or channel

items.name: Learn three Vedic maths tricks
items.about: Quick methods for multiplying and squaring numbers in your head.
howToSteps: Learn to multiply by 11 mentally.
Learn squaring numbers ending in 5.
Practise each trick on ten examples.

ladder.milestone: Do mental maths daily for two weeks
Teach a trick to someone else

items.name: Practise pranayama for 7 days
items.about: Simple breathing exercises like anulom vilom take five minutes and calm the mind.
howToSteps: Sit upright and learn one technique, such as alternate-nostril breathing.
Practise for five minutes each morning.
Stop if you feel dizzy, and keep it gentle.

items.name: Identify 10 bird species near home
items.about: Mynas, bulbuls, sunbirds, kites: there's a lot to spot from a balcony or park.
howToSteps: Go out early in the morning, when birds are most active.
Note colour, size, call and behaviour.
Identify each bird with a field guide or free app.

ladder.milestone: Join a bird walk or count

items.name: Spot a planet and a constellation
items.about: No telescope needed. Venus, Jupiter and Orion are easy to find with the naked eye.
howToSteps: Find a dark spot away from bright lights.
Use a free sky-map app to find a planet.
Trace one constellation, such as Orion or Saptarishi (the Big Dipper).

ladder.milestone: Spot a planet and a constellation
Look through a telescope at Saturn's rings

items.name: Photograph three moon phases
items.about: Watch the moon change over a couple of weeks.
howToSteps: Photograph the moon on three different nights.
Try to capture a crescent, a half and a full moon.
Put the photos side by side.

items.name: Watch a full sunrise
items.about: A simple, memorable experience that costs nothing.
howToSteps: Check tomorrow's sunrise time.
Find a spot with an open eastern view.
Arrive 20 minutes early and watch the whole thing.

ladder.milestone: Watch a sunrise from a hilltop
Watch sunrise and sunset on the same day

items.name: Identify 10 trees on your street
items.about: Neem, peepal, gulmohar, banyan: learn the trees you walk past every day.
howToSteps: Look closely at the leaves, bark, flowers and fruit.
Identify each tree with a guide or app.
Note where each one grows.

ladder.milestone: Map the trees in your area
Join a tree walk or census

items.name: Identify 5 butterflies
items.about: Gardens and parks are full of butterflies, especially after the monsoon.
howToSteps: Visit a flowering garden on a sunny morning.
Photograph butterflies from a respectful distance.
Identify five different species.

ladder.milestone: Plant a host plant for caterpillars

items.name: Walk 5 km somewhere new
items.about: Explore a park, lake or trail you've never walked before.
howToSteps: Pick a safe route you've never walked.
Carry water and wear comfortable shoes.
Walk the full 5 km at an easy pace.

items.name: Do a heritage walk in your city
items.about: Most Indian cities have old quarters, monuments and markets with stories behind them.
howToSteps: Find a local heritage walk or plan your own route.
Read a little about each stop beforehand.
Walk it and note your favourite place.

ladder.milestone: Do a heritage walk in your city
Explore a heritage site in another city

items.name: Complete a beginner day trek
items.about: Short, well-marked trails are a great introduction to the hills.
howToSteps: Choose a popular, well-marked beginner trail.
Go with others and tell someone your plan.
Carry water and snacks, and start early.

ladder.milestone: Do an overnight trek with a group

items.name: Ride 20 km by bicycle
items.about: A borrowed, rented or second-hand bicycle is all you need.
howToSteps: Check the tyres and brakes.
Plan a safe route, ideally early in the morning.
Wear a helmet and ride the full 20 km.

items.name: Fly a kite
items.about: A favourite on Makar Sankranti and Independence Day across India.
howToSteps: Get a paper kite and some cotton string.
Find an open space away from power lines.
Launch into the wind and keep it airborne.

ladder.milestone: Keep a kite up for 30 minutes

items.name: Identify 4 cloud types
items.about: Cumulus, cirrus, stratus, nimbus: the sky changes every day.
howToSteps: Look up a simple cloud chart.
Photograph clouds over a few days.
Match four different types.

ladder.milestone: Identify all ten main cloud types
Predict the weather from the clouds

items.name: Have a picnic in a park
items.about: Pack simple food, a mat and good company. No occasion needed.
howToSteps: Pick a park with shade and clean space.
Pack food, water and a mat or sheet.
Spend at least two hours outdoors, and leave no trace.

ladder.milestone: Have a picnic in a park
Host a picnic for a group

items.name: Visit a botanical garden
items.about: Many Indian cities have botanical gardens with rare and old trees.
howToSteps: Find the nearest botanical garden or large park.
Go in the morning when it's cooler.
Find three plants you've never seen before.

ladder.milestone: Volunteer at a garden or nursery

items.name: Press five leaves or flowers
items.about: Pressed leaves turn into bookmarks, cards and framed art.
howToSteps: Collect five fallen leaves or flowers.
Place them between paper inside a heavy book.
Wait a week, then arrange them on card.

items.name: Take a walk in the rain
items.about: Monsoon is one of India's best seasons to be outdoors, safely.
howToSteps: Pick a safe, familiar route away from flooded areas.
Wear grippy footwear and carry an umbrella or raincoat.
Notice the smells, sounds and green.

ladder.milestone: Take a walk in the rain
Do a monsoon trek with a group

items.name: Camp out for one night
items.about: A night under the stars, at a campsite or even in a garden.
howToSteps: Choose a safe, permitted campsite, or start in a garden.
Borrow or rent a tent and sleeping mat.
Cook a simple meal and stay the night.

items.name: Take a day trip to a fort or ruins
items.about: Most of India is within a few hours of a fort, ruin or old temple town.
howToSteps: Pick a site within two or three hours of home.
Plan transport, water and food.
Spend the day exploring and learn its story.

ladder.milestone: Take a day trip to a fort or ruins
Plan a day trip for friends
Visit a UNESCO World Heritage Site

items.name: Visit a farm and help with a task
items.about: See where food comes from: pick, plant or feed animals.
howToSteps: Find a farm stay, organic farm or relative's farm.
Ask to help with one task.
Learn how one crop is grown.

ladder.milestone: Visit a farm and help with a task
Volunteer for a week on a farm

items.name: Plant a tree
items.about: Plant a native sapling where it can grow for decades.
howToSteps: Get permission and pick a sunny spot.
Choose a native sapling such as neem or jamun.
Plant it, water it and check on it weekly.

ladder.milestone: Keep it alive through a summer

items.name: Grow tulsi, mint or coriander
items.about: A single pot on a windowsill is enough for a kitchen herb.
howToSteps: Fill a pot with soil and plant seeds or a cutting.
Keep it in sunlight and water it lightly.
Harvest your first leaves.

ladder.milestone: Grow a herb from seed to harvest

items.name: Harvest a tray of microgreens
items.about: Mustard, methi or moong microgreens are ready in about a week.
howToSteps: Spread soaked seeds densely on soil in a shallow tray.
Mist with water daily and keep it in indirect light.
Snip the greens when they're 5–8 cm tall.

items.name: Start a kitchen compost bin
items.about: Turn vegetable peels into rich soil for your plants.
howToSteps: Make holes in a bucket or bin for air.
Layer vegetable scraps with dry leaves or paper.
Mix it weekly and keep it moist, not wet.

items.name: Root a money-plant cutting
items.about: Grow a new plant from a single cutting in a glass of water.
howToSteps: Cut a stem just below a node.
Place it in a glass of water.
Change the water weekly until roots appear.

items.name: Bake a loaf of bread
items.about: Flour, water, yeast and salt. Baking your first loaf is very satisfying.
howToSteps: Mix and knead a simple dough.
Let it rise until it doubles in size.
Shape it and bake until golden.

ladder.milestone: Bake pav for a family meal

items.name: Make a small jar of pickle
items.about: A quick nimbu or mango pickle is a taste of home-kitchen tradition.
howToSteps: Chop fresh lime or raw mango.
Mix with salt, spices and oil as a family or trusted recipe says.
Store it in a clean, dry jar and let it mature.

ladder.milestone: Make a small jar of pickle
Learn a family recipe from an elder
Make a season's batch to share

items.name: Set curd or ferment batter from scratch
items.about: Dahi and idli batter are everyday ferments, and fun to get right yourself.
howToSteps: Warm milk and add a spoon of curd, or grind soaked rice and urad dal.
Leave it covered somewhere warm overnight.
Check the texture and taste the next day.

ladder.milestone: Set curd or ferment batter from scratch

items.name: Make masala chai from whole spices
items.about: Crush your own cardamom, ginger and cloves for a fragrant cup.
howToSteps: Crush cardamom, cloves and ginger.
Simmer the spices in water, then add tea leaves.
Add milk and sugar, bring it to a boil and strain.

ladder.milestone: Make masala chai from whole spices
Make your own chai masala blend

items.name: Cook a new recipe on your own
items.about: Pick a dish you've never made and follow the recipe start to finish.
howToSteps: Choose a simple recipe with under ten ingredients.
Prepare and measure everything before you start.
Cook it and share it with someone.

ladder.milestone: Cook a new recipe on your own

items.name: Build a mini terrarium
items.about: A tiny garden in a glass jar, with layers of pebbles, charcoal, soil and small plants.
howToSteps: Layer pebbles, then soil, in a clean glass jar.
Plant two or three small, slow-growing plants.
Add moss or stones and mist lightly.

ladder.milestone: Keep it healthy for three months

items.name: Bake a batch of cookies
items.about: Cookies are forgiving and quick, the perfect first bake.
howToSteps: Follow a simple butter-cookie or nankhatai recipe.
Portion the dough evenly on a tray.
Bake until just golden at the edges.

items.name: Make a candle
items.about: Melt wax, add a wick and pour. Diwali diyas and jar candles are easy starts.
howToSteps: Melt soy or paraffin wax gently in a double boiler.
Fix a wick in a jar or diya.
Pour, let it set, and never leave melting wax alone.

items.name: Make a small jar of jam
items.about: Fruit and sugar, cooked down. Seasonal mangoes or strawberries work well.
howToSteps: Chop ripe fruit and add sugar and lemon juice.
Cook, stirring, until it thickens.
Pour into a clean jar and let it cool.

ladder.milestone: Make a small jar of jam

items.name: Grow tomatoes in a pot
items.about: Cherry tomatoes grow happily on a sunny balcony.
howToSteps: Plant a seedling in a large pot with good soil.
Give it six hours of sun and water regularly.
Support it with a stick and harvest when red.

ladder.milestone: Grow a month's worth of greens

items.name: Brew South Indian filter coffee
items.about: Decoction, hot milk and the famous pour between tumbler and dabarah.
howToSteps: Add coffee powder to the top chamber of a filter and pour in hot water.
Let the decoction drip through.
Mix with hot milk and sugar, and froth by pouring.

items.name: Make paneer at home
items.about: Paneer needs just milk and lemon juice, and is ready in under an hour.
howToSteps: Bring full-fat milk to a boil.
Add lemon juice until it curdles.
Strain through cloth and press under a weight.

ladder.milestone: Cook a dish with your own paneer

items.name: Sing a full song by heart
items.about: Learn every word of one song and sing it through.
howToSteps: Pick a song you love.
Learn the lyrics verse by verse.
Sing the whole song without reading the words.

ladder.milestone: Sing a full song by heart
Take a singing class or join a choir

items.name: Learn a basic beat
items.about: Learn a simple taal on a dholak, tabla or just a table top.
howToSteps: Learn a simple pattern, such as teental counting.
Tap it slowly with a metronome app.
Play it for one minute without losing the beat.

items.name: Play a simple tune
items.about: Harmonica, bansuri or ukulele are friendly first instruments.
howToSteps: Choose an affordable beginner instrument.
Learn the notes of a simple tune.
Play it from start to finish.

ladder.milestone: Practise 20 minutes daily for a month

items.name: Learn a full dance routine
items.about: From Bollywood to folk, follow a tutorial and learn one routine end to end.
howToSteps: Pick a beginner routine video.
Learn it in short sections.
Dance the whole routine without pausing.

items.name: Do 100 skips without stopping
items.about: A skipping rope is cheap, portable and great exercise.
howToSteps: Adjust the rope to your height.
Practise steady, low jumps.
Build up to 100 in a row.

items.name: Play a game of gully cricket
items.about: India's favourite street game. All you need is a bat, a ball and friends.
howToSteps: Gather a few friends and a safe open space.
Agree on local rules and boundaries.
Play a full match.

ladder.milestone: Play a game of gully cricket
Play every weekend for a month
Join a local club net session

items.name: Win a game of carrom
items.about: A classic Indian table game of flicks and angles.
howToSteps: Learn the basic rules and scoring.
Practise striking towards the pockets.
Play and win one game.

items.name: Play kho-kho or kabaddi
items.about: Two traditional Indian team games that need no equipment at all.
howToSteps: Gather enough players for two teams.
Learn the basic rules.
Play one full game.

items.name: Juggle three balls for 10 catches
items.about: Start with one ball, then two, then three.
howToSteps: Practise throwing one ball in an arc from hand to hand.
Add a second ball, then a third.
Keep going until you make 10 catches in a row.

ladder.milestone: Learn a trick such as the shower

items.name: Learn and perform a card trick
items.about: One good trick, practised well, can delight a whole room.
howToSteps: Learn a simple self-working card trick.
Practise it ten times in front of a mirror.
Perform it for a friend.

ladder.milestone: Learn and perform a card trick

items.name: Land a yo-yo trick
items.about: Start with a sleeper, then walk the dog.
howToSteps: Get a responsive beginner yo-yo.
Learn to throw a sleeper that spins for 3 seconds.
Land 'walk the dog' three times.

items.name: Play a round of antakshari
items.about: The singing game where each song starts with the last letter of the previous one.
howToSteps: Gather friends or family into two teams.
Start with a song and follow the last-letter rule.
Play until one team is stumped.

items.name: Beatbox a basic beat
items.about: Kick, hi-hat and snare, all with your mouth.
howToSteps: Learn the three basic sounds: 'b', 't' and 'pf'.
Combine them into a simple 4-beat pattern.
Keep it going for 30 seconds.

items.name: Play a game of lagori (pittu)
items.about: Knock down a stack of stones with a ball, then rebuild it before you're tagged.
howToSteps: Stack seven flat stones.
Split into two teams and take turns throwing.
Rebuild the stack while dodging the other team.

items.name: Learn a basic Bharatanatyam adavu
items.about: Adavus are the building-block steps of Bharatanatyam.
howToSteps: Watch a beginner tutorial on the first adavu (tatta adavu).
Practise the posture (aramandi) and rhythm slowly.
Perform eight counts cleanly.

items.name: Play a full game of table tennis
items.about: Fast, fun and found in many clubs and community centres.
howToSteps: Find a table at a club, school or community centre.
Learn to serve and keep a rally going.
Play a full game to 11 points.

ladder.milestone: Play a full game of table tennis

items.name: Shoot a 10-photo themed series
items.about: Pick a theme, such as doors, shadows or chai stalls, and tell a story in ten shots.
howToSteps: Choose a theme.
Take many photos over a day or two.
Pick your best ten and arrange them in order.

ladder.milestone: Learn the rule of thirds and light
Shoot a themed series every month
Exhibit or publish a photo series

items.name: Photograph one street from morning to evening
items.about: The same place looks completely different as the light and people change.
howToSteps: Choose a street you can return to safely.
Photograph it in the morning, afternoon and evening.
Compare the shots side by side.

ladder.milestone: Photograph one street from morning to evening

items.name: Edit a 30-second clip of your day
items.about: Learn the basics of cutting clips and adding music with a free phone editor.
howToSteps: Record short clips throughout one day.
Trim them into a 30-second sequence.
Add music or text and export it.

ladder.milestone: Edit a 30-second clip of your day
Make a short film with a story

items.name: Make a 10-second stop-motion clip
items.about: Move an object a little, take a photo, repeat. A free app stitches it together.
howToSteps: Pick a small object, such as a toy, clay or coins.
Fix your phone steady and take 50+ photos, moving it slightly each time.
Play it back at 10 frames per second.

ladder.milestone: Make a stop-motion short with sound

items.name: Record a 10-minute podcast episode
items.about: Just your phone, a quiet room and something you care about.
howToSteps: Pick a topic and jot down three talking points.
Record in a quiet room, phone close to you.
Trim the start and end and listen back.

items.name: Shoot a time-lapse
items.about: Clouds, traffic or a sunset, sped up.
howToSteps: Set your phone on something steady facing a changing scene.
Use the time-lapse mode for at least 15 minutes.
Watch it back and share it.

items.name: Take one photo a day for a week
items.about: A tiny daily habit that makes you notice your surroundings.
howToSteps: Take one deliberate photo each day.
Pick a daily prompt, such as 'red' or 'shadow'.
Make a seven-photo collage at the end.

ladder.milestone: Take one photo a day for a week

items.name: Write a blog post about a place
items.about: Share a place you know well with tips only a local would know.
howToSteps: Pick a place: a market, a café or a temple.
Write 500 words with three tips and two photos.
Publish it on a free blog platform.

ladder.milestone: Write a blog post about a place
Get your first comment from a stranger
Write a guide to your city

items.name: Run 2 km without stopping
items.about: Start with run-walk intervals and build up gradually.
howToSteps: Alternate one minute running and two minutes walking.
Repeat three times a week, adding running time.
Run 2 km continuously at an easy pace.

ladder.milestone: Run three times a week for a month

items.name: Stretch for 10 minutes daily for a week
items.about: Gentle stretching eases stiffness, especially after sitting all day.
howToSteps: Follow a beginner full-body stretch routine.
Hold each stretch 20–30 seconds without bouncing.
Repeat daily for seven days.

ladder.milestone: Stretch for 10 minutes daily for a week

items.name: Swim 10 lengths of a pool
items.about: Swimming works the whole body and is easy on the joints.
howToSteps: Find a public pool with lifeguards.
Take lessons first if you can't swim yet.
Swim 10 lengths at your own pace, resting as needed.

items.name: Hold a plank for 1 minute
items.about: A plank builds core strength with no equipment.
howToSteps: Start on your forearms and toes with a straight body.
Hold for 20 seconds, rest, and repeat.
Build up to one full minute over a week.

items.name: Do 20 push-ups
items.about: Start against a wall or on your knees, then progress to full push-ups.
howToSteps: Start with wall or knee push-ups.
Do three sets a few times a week.
Work up to 20 full push-ups in a row.

items.name: Climb 20 floors in a day
items.about: Stairs are a free workout built into every building.
howToSteps: Take the stairs instead of the lift all day.
Count the floors you climb.
Reach 20 floors by evening.

items.name: Do a Zumba session
items.about: Dance-based fitness to upbeat music. Fun even if you can't dance.
howToSteps: Find a free online class or a local trial session.
Wear comfortable shoes and keep water nearby.
Follow along for the full session.

ladder.milestone: Learn a full routine by heart

items.name: Play a game of badminton
items.about: One of India's most-played sports, in parks, courts and colonies.
howToSteps: Find a partner and a court or open space.
Learn the serve and basic rally.
Play a full game to 21.

ladder.milestone: Learn the smash and drop shot

items.name: Play a football match with friends
items.about: Five-a-side in a park or turf is easy to organise.
howToSteps: Gather eight to ten people.
Book a turf or find an open ground.
Play a full match, warming up first.

ladder.milestone: Play a football match with friends

items.name: Try indoor bouldering
items.about: Short climbing routes over padded floors. No ropes, and beginners welcome.
howToSteps: Find a climbing gym and book a beginner session.
Learn how to fall safely and read route grades.
Complete three of the easiest problems.

ladder.milestone: Try outdoor climbing with a guide

items.name: Walk 10,000 steps in a day
items.about: Spread walks through the day: a morning stroll, walking calls, an evening loop.
howToSteps: Turn on your phone's step counter.
Add three short walks to your day.
Reach 10,000 by bedtime.

ladder.milestone: Hit 10,000 five days in a week

items.name: Skate 50 m without falling
items.about: Roller skating rinks and coaching are common in many Indian cities.
howToSteps: Wear a helmet and knee and elbow pads.
Practise balancing and small gliding steps.
Skate 50 m in one go.

items.name: Take a martial arts trial class
items.about: Karate, taekwondo or kalaripayattu: most schools offer a free first class.
howToSteps: Find a school offering a beginner trial.
Wear comfortable clothes and arrive early.
Complete the class and learn one technique.

ladder.milestone: Take a martial arts trial class
Learn a full form or kata

items.name: Make 10 free throws
items.about: Find a hoop in a park or school and practise your shot.
howToSteps: Stand at the free-throw line.
Use the same simple routine for every shot.
Keep shooting until you've made 10.

items.name: Complete a 20-minute home workout
items.about: Bodyweight circuits need no gym and no equipment.
howToSteps: Pick a beginner 20-minute video.
Warm up, then follow at your own pace.
Finish with a cool-down stretch.

ladder.milestone: Work out three times a week

items.name: Learn a 5-minute tai chi sequence
items.about: Slow, flowing movements for balance and calm.
howToSteps: Follow a beginner tai chi video.
Move slowly and breathe steadily.
Practise the sequence until you can do it without the video.

items.name: Hula hoop for 2 minutes
items.about: A heavier adult hoop is easier to keep up than a kids' one.
howToSteps: Use a hoop that reaches about your waist.
Push it around and rock your hips forward and back.
Keep it going for 2 minutes.

ladder.milestone: Hoop to a whole song with tricks

items.name: Join a community 5 km walk or run
items.about: Free weekly 5 km events and charity runs welcome walkers and runners alike.
howToSteps: Find a free weekly 5K or a charity run near you.
Register and turn up a bit early.
Walk or run the whole course at your own pace.

ladder.milestone: Join a community 5 km walk or run

items.name: Learn 10 Indian Sign Language signs
items.about: Greetings, thank you, family and numbers are a great start.
howToSteps: Find a free ISL video course.
Learn greetings, thank you and family signs.
Sign them to someone and explain what they mean.

items.name: Build a one-page website
items.about: A few lines of HTML in a free online editor make a real web page.
howToSteps: Open a free online HTML editor.
Add a heading, a paragraph and an image.
Change the colours and share the link.

ladder.milestone: Add a style sheet and a second page

items.name: Type 40 words per minute
items.about: Typing without looking saves hours every year.
howToSteps: Use a free typing tutor for 15 minutes a day.
Keep your fingers on the home row.
Take a test once you're comfortable.

items.name: Watch a documentary and note 5 facts
items.about: Nature, history or science: watch actively and learn something.
howToSteps: Pick a documentary on a topic new to you.
Write down five things that surprised you.
Tell someone the most interesting one.

ladder.milestone: Watch a documentary and note 5 facts
Read a book on the same topic
Visit a place from a documentary

items.name: Learn basic first aid
items.about: Knowing CPR and how to treat burns or cuts can save a life.
howToSteps: Find a free online or Red Cross first-aid module.
Learn CPR steps, recovery position and burn care.
Assemble a basic first-aid kit at home.

items.name: Visit a museum and find 3 favourites
items.about: Most cities have a museum you've walked past but never visited.
howToSteps: Pick a museum near you.
Spend at least an hour inside.
Choose three favourite exhibits and learn their stories.

ladder.milestone: Visit a museum and find 3 favourites

items.name: Learn 5 useful knots
items.about: The reef knot, bowline, clove hitch, sheet bend and figure-eight.
howToSteps: Get a piece of rope or cord.
Learn each knot from a diagram or video.
Tie each from memory.

ladder.milestone: Use knots on a camping trip

items.name: Find your way with a map and compass
items.about: A paper map and compass work when phones don't.
howToSteps: Get a local map and a basic compass.
Learn to orient the map to north.
Navigate to three points in a park.

ladder.milestone: Find your way with a map and compass
Plan a route for a group

items.name: Finish one module of a free online course
items.about: Free university courses cover almost any subject.
howToSteps: Pick a free course on a topic you're curious about.
Complete the first module and its quiz.
Write down the three key ideas.

ladder.milestone: Finish one module of a free online course

items.name: Fix a bicycle puncture
items.about: A basic repair that saves money and long walks home.
howToSteps: Remove the wheel and tyre lever off the tyre.
Find the hole and patch it, or fit a new tube.
Refit the tyre and pump it up.

items.name: Fix something broken at home
items.about: A loose hinge, a wobbly chair or a torn cushion. Repair instead of replace.
howToSteps: Pick one small broken thing.
Watch a repair tutorial for it.
Fix it with basic tools.

ladder.milestone: Hold a repair session for neighbours

items.name: Build a simple circuit
items.about: Light an LED with a battery, a resistor and a switch.
howToSteps: Get a beginner kit with a battery, LED, resistor and wires.
Follow a diagram to connect them.
Add a switch to turn it on and off.

ladder.milestone: Build a circuit with a sensor

items.name: Learn the history of your neighbourhood
items.about: Every street name and old building has a story.
howToSteps: Ask an elder or search for your area's history.
Find out how three street or place names came about.
Visit the oldest building near you.

ladder.milestone: Learn the history of your neighbourhood
Write a short history of your area

items.name: Recognise 5 birds by their call
items.about: Koels, bulbuls and barbets are often heard before they're seen.
howToSteps: Use a free birdsong app or recordings.
Listen outside at dawn.
Match five calls to the right birds.

items.name: Do a science experiment at home
items.about: Grow crystals, make a lava lamp or test what floats. Kitchen science is fun at any age.
howToSteps: Pick a safe kitchen experiment.
Predict what will happen, then try it.
Write down what actually happened and why.

ladder.milestone: Do a science experiment at home
Grow sugar crystals over a week
Run a science afternoon for kids

items.name: Volunteer for a day
items.about: Food banks, animal shelters and NGOs all welcome one-day volunteers.
howToSteps: Find a local NGO or shelter that takes volunteers.
Sign up for a single shift.
Show up, help out and ask how you can return.

items.name: Attend a local club or meetup
items.about: Hiking, chess, photography or coding: there's a group for almost everything.
howToSteps: Search for a meetup in an interest you have.
Go to one session, even if alone.
Talk to at least two people.

ladder.milestone: Attend a local club or meetup

items.name: Host a board game night
items.about: Ludo, Monopoly or something new. Games bring people together.
howToSteps: Invite three or more friends.
Pick one or two easy games.
Play, snack and laugh.

ladder.milestone: Learn a new modern board game
Join a board game café night

items.name: Cook a meal for friends
items.about: Feeding people is one of the oldest ways to show care.
howToSteps: Invite two to four friends.
Plan a simple menu you can cook ahead.
Cook, serve and enjoy together.

items.name: Join a cleanup drive
items.about: Beaches, lakes and streets get cleaner one bag at a time.
howToSteps: Find a local cleanup group or start a small one.
Bring gloves and bags.
Collect litter for an hour and dispose of it properly.

ladder.milestone: Adopt a spot to keep clean

items.name: Teach someone a skill
items.about: Teaching something you know, such as a recipe, a song or an app, helps you learn it better too.
howToSteps: Pick something you're good at.
Break it into three simple steps.
Teach it to a friend, child or elder.

items.name: Join or start a book club meeting
items.about: Reading together gives you a reason to finish and someone to talk to.
howToSteps: Find a local or online book club, or invite two friends.
Read the chosen book or a part of it.
Join the discussion and share one opinion.

ladder.milestone: Join or start a book club meeting
Pick a book for the group

items.name: Attend a local festival or mela
items.about: Melas, harvest festivals and cultural fairs are full of food, music and crafts.
howToSteps: Find a fair or festival happening near you.
Go with friends or family.
Try a new food, watch a performance and buy one handmade thing.

ladder.milestone: Attend a local festival or mela

items.name: Take part in a quiz night
items.about: Pub quizzes, college quizzes and online quizzes are great team fun.
howToSteps: Find a quiz night or an online quiz.
Team up with friends.
Play the whole quiz and learn three new facts.

ladder.milestone: Take part in a quiz night
Write and host your own quiz

items.name: Sing at a karaoke night
items.about: Everyone sounds better when the whole room is singing along.
howToSteps: Find a karaoke night or use a karaoke app at home.
Pick a song you know well.
Sing it all the way through.

ladder.milestone: Sing a song in another language

items.name: Call an old friend
items.about: A real conversation with someone you've lost touch with.
howToSteps: Think of someone you miss.
Message to find a good time.
Call and talk for at least 20 minutes.

items.name: Organise a potluck
items.about: Everyone brings one dish. Low effort, big feast.
howToSteps: Invite friends or neighbours and set a date.
Ask each person to bring one dish.
Host, eat and swap recipes.

ladder.milestone: Organise one for your whole building

items.name: Attend an open mic night
items.about: Poetry, music and comedy from local performers. Maybe you'll perform next time.
howToSteps: Find an open mic at a café or community space.
Go and support the performers.
Note one act that inspired you.

items.name: Do a random act of kindness

howToSteps: Think of something small: pay for a chai, help carry bags, leave a kind note.
Do it without expecting anything back.
Notice how it feels.

ladder.milestone: Do a random act of kindness

Start a kindness challenge with friends

items.name: Record an elder's story
items.about: Grandparents and elders hold stories that disappear if no one asks.

Record a 15-minute conversation on your phone, with permission.
Save it and share it with the family.
